help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Provides a 20% chance to cause knockdown to your targets, enhances the damage of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Damage.Scale}%, and converts any Knockback this power deals into Knockdown.  Some powers may have their chance to Knockdown reduced when this enhancement is slotted.  This enhancement also has a penchant for the dramatic...
power_display_names: Imperial Might: Recharge/Chance for Knockdown/Knockback to Knockdown
power_short_helps: +Rech, Chance for Knockdown, Converts Knockback to Knockdown
